recipe.build:
echo -e "PRIVATE_DNS_QS_RELEASE_STORE_FILE=/dev/null\nPRIVATE_DNS_QS_RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD=storePass\nPRIVATE_DNS_QS_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS=keyAlias\nPRIVATE_DNS_QS_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD=keyPass" >> gradle.properties
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i app/build.gradle
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew assembleRelease
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
